name: Mr Wolf
source:
“All that matters is that you try your best…”

A shy young man who sky-rocketed into the limelight thanks to his musical talent.

[From [url=http://synokoria.tumblr.com/Halloween_Otome]official site[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Tyler. He's a famous singer who goes by the stage name Tyger. He was working as a cook at a five-star seafood restaurant when his producer discovered him.[/spoiler]
